raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

- Add `@yulangz` as a code owner for the nine requested core and v2 modules.
- Assign `/areal/reward/prm/` exclusively to `@dingzhiqiang` and `@fishcrap`.
- Add `@daihaowz` for `/areal/api/`, `/areal/infra/`, and `/areal/trainer/` while retaining their existing owners.
- Remove `@rchardx` and `@nuzant` from all CODEOWNERS rules, including documentation and `.github`.

## Related Issue

None specified.

## Type of Change

Governance / maintainer ownership update.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

## Additional Context

Validation:
- `pre-commit run --files .github/CODEOWNERS` passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- A CODEOWNERS rule check confirmed `@yulangz` in exactly the nine requested module rules and no `@rchardx` or `@nuzant` in any rule.
- A PRM rule check confirmed `@dingzhiqiang` and `@fishcrap` are its only owners.
- A rule check confirmed `@daihaowz` appears only in the three requested modules.
- `pre-commit run --all-files` was run, but returned nonzero because hooks regenerated unrelated lockfiles. Those generated changes were reverted before committing.

No runtime tests were run because this changes reviewer ownership only.
